title: I Am God (Digital Circus)
blurb: The Amazing Digital Circus landed in October 2023 and did numbers almost nobody expected — a Glitch Productions pilot about people trapped inside a garish virtual circus, watched hundreds of millions of times before a second episode existed. Its dialogue escaped into meme circulation almost immediately, and this grandiose declaration was one of the first lines out of the gate. Delivered with total conviction and no supporting evidence whatsoever, it suits any moment of wildly unearned confidence: winning a single round, fixing one bug, finally getting a jar open.
origin: A line from The Amazing Digital Circus (Glitch Productions, 2023).
